context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly implements a provider-defined function with proper Definition, Run method, error handling, and tests.

checklist.name: Function interface
checklist.description: The function type implements function.Function interface with Metadata, Definition, and Run methods

checklist.name: Metadata name
checklist.description: Metadata method sets resp.Name to parse_id

checklist.name: Definition parameters
checklist.description: Definition has a Summary, Description, one StringParameter for the input, and a StringReturn for the result

checklist.name: Run reads arguments
checklist.description: Run method reads the input argument using req.Arguments.Get and checks for errors using function.ConcatFuncErrors or direct error check

checklist.name: Run parsing logic
checklist.description: Run method splits the input string on colon and returns the name portion (second part) via resp.Result.Set

checklist.name: Run error handling
checklist.description: Run method returns a function error (using function.NewArgumentFuncError or function.NewFuncError) when the input format is invalid

checklist.name: Provider registration
checklist.description: Provider implements ProviderWithFunctions interface with a Functions method that returns the parse_id function

checklist.name: Unit test
checklist.description: A unit test exists that constructs RunRequest with function.NewArgumentsData, calls Run, and asserts the result for both valid and invalid inputs

checklist.name: Correct imports
checklist.description: Code imports the function package from terraform-plugin-framework (github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework/function)
